fixtures.name: distracted_boyfriend
fixtures.description: Three people. A man walks hand-in-hand with his girlfriend but turns his head 180° to look back at another woman passing by. His girlfriend glares at him. The other woman looks straight ahead away from the couple.
expected_relations: man looks at passing woman (face on the left)
passing woman does not look at either of the other two

fixtures.name: yalta_conference
fixtures.description: Historic 1945 photograph of Churchill, Roosevelt, and Stalin seated together, with aides/officers in the background. A group-photo stress test: every face should get its own gaze trajectory drawn.
expected_relations: Churchill, Roosevelt, Stalin (large bboxes at the front) should all read as frontal/out-of-frame (posed photograph)
background officers should each get a trajectory — not accurate ground truth, but useful to eyeball consistency

fixtures.name: woman_yelling_at_cat
fixtures.description: Composite meme. Left panel: one woman yelling and pointing, a second woman restraining her (both looking to the right). Right panel: a white cat at a dinner table looking slightly left.
expected_relations: the two human faces on the left both gaze toward the right side of the frame (toward the cat panel)

fixtures.name: disaster_girl
fixtures.description: A young girl smiling mischievously toward the lens while a house burns in the background. Often described as a 'looking at camera' meme, though in the original photo her eyes are actually turned to her right — she's watching people/firefighters off-frame.
expected_relations: single face; gaze direction ambiguous — could reasonably read as 'looking at camera' (due to smile/framing) or 'looking off to the side' (the true eye direction)
